hero.subtitle: Full Stack Developer
hero.description: I turn ideas into amazing digital experiences. Specialized in React, Node.js and modern technologies to create scalable and robust web solutions.

about.cardParagraph1: With over 5 years of experience in web development, I specialize in creating modern and scalable applications using the latest technologies in the market.
about.cardParagraph2: My journey started with curiosity about how things work on the web, and today I turn complex ideas into elegant and functional digital solutions.
about.cardParagraph3: I believe that the best code is the one that solves real problems in a simple way, always keeping the focus on the user experience and the quality of the final product.

cards.cleanCodeDescription: Clean and well-structured code is my passion.
cards.innovationDescription: Always looking for creative and efficient solutions.
cards.collaborationDescription: Teamwork and clear communication are essential.
cards.dedicationDescription: Committed to excellence in every project.

journey.description: How curiosity about technology turned into a passion for programming
journey.firstDescription: I discovered that I could create something from scratch just by typing code in a technical course. I fell in love with programming and started learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
journey.continousDescription: Each project is a new adventure. From the frontend to the backend, each line of code teaches me something new. Programming is not just my job - it's my way of solving problems and creating impact.
journey.connectingPeopleDescription: What motivates me the most is knowing that behind each application are real people. I develop thinking about how I can make someone's life easier, create connections, and generate genuine value.
journey.quote: 'Technology is better when it brings people closer.' - Matt Mullenweg
journey.quoteConnect: Shall we build something amazing together? 👇
